note: Stable filtered cursor pagination over an append-only event feed.
prompt: Implement cursor pagination for the event feed. The first request captures the current end of the feed; subsequent pages must return matching events from that same snapshot in sequence order, even if more events are appended. A continuation retains its filter, may use a different page size, and rejects malformed cursors or an explicitly changed filter. Return a next cursor only when another matching event remains. Run `tsc --noEmit -p . && node --test`; Node runs TypeScript directly and no installation is needed. Do not edit, delete, or skip protected tests or tsconfig.json.
